description: On-chain governance proposals (treasury withdrawals, parameter changes, hard forks, committee and constitution changes, info actions) with status, epochs, requested ADA and the current yes/no vote share (percent of voting power) of DReps and stake pools. Use it for questions about what Cardano is voting on.

limit.description: How many actions, newest first, to return (1-30, default 10).

query.description: Only actions whose title contains this text.

name: list_governance_actions
title: Cardano governance actions
